entities.summary: Messaoud Hai Victor Perez was a Tunisian Jewish boxer, who became the World Flyweight Champion in 1931 and 1932, fighting under his ring name Young Perez. He was managed by Leon Bellier. He was a victim of the Holocaust having been imprisoned at the Auschwitz concentration camp before making a death march to Gleiwitz where he was killed.
